description: AI-generated styled alfajor photography, based on the bakery's actual three-sizes-closeup image. Not photographs of fulfilled orders.

params.prompt:
[SCENE]
Intimate late-morning bakery kitchen still life. A small natural stack of three reference alfajores on a warm ivory ceramic plate, with one more cookie resting beside the stack. Tight appetizing portrait framing; the cookies occupy most of the image.
[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
Match the actual alfajores in the supplied reference extremely closely: rustic pale golden shortbread sandwich cookies with gently scalloped round edges, modest natural thickness, a generous but believable visible band of caramel-brown manjar blanco, dusty uneven powdered sugar on top, real crumbly porous baked texture and tiny handmade irregularities. Preserve the reference cookie proportions and character. Do not redesign into macarons, American chocolate-chip cookies or thick cakes. No coconut coating, no dripping caramel, no extra filling layers. The reference is the product identity, not a composition to copy. Cookies are the unmistakable focal anchor, photographed as a real small homemade bakery product, not a luxury factory confection.
[HUMAN ELEMENT]
No people; subtle traces of a real shared coffee moment.
[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Matte ivory plate, a narrow edge of muted brick-red and cream Peruvian woven textile with restrained Andean geometric details, warm cream plaster wall falling softly out of focus, a few natural shortbread crumbs. Avoid the busy multicolored background of the reference.
[LIGHTING]
Large soft window light from camera-left at 45 degrees, 5000K daylight balanced slightly warm, natural white bounce fill, gentle shadow falloff, grounded contact shadows, preserved sugar highlights, no blown-out whites.
[LENS & CAMERA]
85mm lens, f/5.6, three-quarter view at cookie level, tack-sharp focus on the front scalloped edges, sugar texture and caramel filling, background subtly soft.
[ATMOSPHERE]
Warm, intimate, appetizing and believable. A real photograph of freshly baked homemade alfajores; retain small imperfections.
[COLOR PALETTE]
Warm cream, deep brick crimson #a31f1f, natural caramel-brown filling. Restrained saturation, natural tonal contrast.
[STYLE REFERENCE]
Warm food storytelling, natural appetizing food detail, bright tactile handmade lifestyle photography, restrained commercial retouching.
[QUALITY MARKERS]
Editorial commercial standard, tack-sharp commercial photography, ultra-realistic textures and materials, professional retouching standard, no AI artifacts.
[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image, no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering, no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects, no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look, no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash, no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions, no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures, no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look, no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones that look out of place from the rest of the scene. No stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look, no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments, no perfect symmetry where natural asymmetry should be, no clipart elements, no flat illustration mixed with photo, no obviously composited backgrounds. No floating cookies, no fake steam, no mountains or flags as a decorative cliché.
resolution: 2k
